snippet.title: Vitrified - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4186550/Vitrified_Demo/

Vitrified is a Fallout and Dune inspired metroidvania where progress depends on teamwork with your robot pal ALAN. Explore a mysterious mutant wasteland and upgrade ALAN with abilities to unlock new areas.
